description: An unsigned regulatory relationship from a transcription-factor protein to a target gene. The relationship does not distinguish activation from repression.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was last updated.

common_properties.name: detection_methods
common_properties.description: Methods reported for the regulatory interaction, including PSI-MI method labels. The value `inferred by curator` is retained and may be the only method; such a relationship names no experimental method.
common_properties.notes: Deduplicated; unioned across all source rows contributing to the pair. Both list properties are order-insensitive. Detection methods and PubMed IDs are not parallel lists.

common_properties.name: pubmed_ids
common_properties.description: PubMed identifiers of publications reporting the interaction. Values may include malformed identifiers because source tokens are retained without validation or repair.
common_properties.notes: Deduplicated; unioned across all source rows contributing to the pair. Stored as strings, verbatim and unvalidated. Detection methods and PubMed IDs are not parallel lists.

source_contributions.scope: Human interactions from the TFLink v1.0 small-scale, literature-curated subset. Only pairs with both endpoints present in SPOKE and a single, nonmissing target gene identifier are represented. Excluding ambiguous target identifiers systematically reduces representation of histone and interferon gene families; absence of their relationships is not a biological conclusion. Transcription-factor autoregulation is included.
source_contributions.description: TFLink is a curated catalogue assembled from upstream interaction databases. The selected subset retains its full evidence trail, including evidence from large-scale databases that independently support the same interaction. Detection methods and publications are independent evidence lists with no positional correspondence.
